v3_onnx_static_audit.audit: M19-C0.3 independent frozen Cinque V3 dataset sufficiency audit
navigation_findings: The exact original graph has four non-state external inputs and three recurrent state inputs; nav_map and navigation are absent from the inputs and complete tensor name inventory.

All output graph dependency closures terminate in those seven declared inputs or embedded initializers. There are no unresolved tensors, external initializers or nested graphs. The one local function, org.tinygrad::Contiguous, was inspected and consists solely of an ONNX Identity(input -> output), with no attributes or external dependencies.
Exact5bb ModelSpec.packed_shapes includes nav_map/navigation only if declared by the selected model; frozen Cinque V3 yields desire, traffic_convention and action_t only (12 float32 values).

Exact5bb MapInput.update returns immediately when selected views lack nav_map. fill_inputs ignores absent nav views. The native camera warp accepts frame, big_frame and calibration transforms, with no nav_map/navigation parameter; new_img records its postwarp result.

Exact5bb deferred_map is gated by output_projection.eligible to N16 model SHA 01effc679eb46d6036ce0302673a87fe2dcfcc95a679daeeb929679e53c3647a and exact N16 spec SHA 63b2097c114bade03c5ec7ded978d73032a93bb525c03f9b78eddf49809f8b71. Cinque V3 SHA 404a18… fails that eligibility, so N16 deferred map staging does not add a hidden Cinque V3 input.

A navigation/control effect upstream of the final desire or action_t values is already represented when those final post-fill_inputs values are recorded; sufficiency does not imply ability to reconstruct those values from raw vehicle messages.

decisions.scope: Frozen SHA 404a18… original ONNX model-input replay, with recurrent state managed separately and final per-frame tensor bytes recorded.

recurrence_conditions: A segment must begin with the same zero reset as the reference or an exact snapshot of all three state tensors. Arbitrary middle-of-session frames plus zero state do not recreate prior outputs.

Feed validated next_state_img_q, next_state_desire_q and next_state_feat_q back to their respective inputs in original order. Preserve frame order, gaps and reset/session boundaries; frame_skip=4 remains pinned.

TRT 10.3 adapter converts new_img/state_img_q/next_state_img_q storage to float16 while preserving 0..255 image values; raw dataset bytes remain uint8. This audit confirms the raw graph contract only and does not establish TRT parity.
limits: Independent of recorder byte-exactness: a PASS here cannot validate where a recorder reads or hashes buffers, endian handling, concurrency, or whether a source patch still applies.
No new ONNX inference, ORT numerical parity, TensorRT build/load/inference, Jetson/comma/USB access, capture, transport test, timing, fallback or vehicle validation was performed.

Sufficiency applies to postwarp, post-fill_inputs model-input replay for this frozen SHA. Raw camera/preprocessing reproduction needs camera frames and calibration transforms; changing model identity/spec (including N16) requires a fresh contract audit.
Dataset representativeness, warmup length, recurrence/output equality and latency remain separate validation questions.

This result does not approve four fields for N16 or every selectable model. A selected model declaring nav_map/navigation needs those values (and every declared state tensor) to reproduce its model inputs.

checks.evidence: All 22 changed extracted blobs SHA256-match source-manifest.json after hashes; six production files and three tests in scope reviewed against exact.diff. No target source edits.

C-owned copy per pending slot, obj+sequence+exact res/res2 validation, sticky error. Synchronous depth16 x32768; deferred 1MiB depth32 x32768 or depth128 x8192. Native tempfile AIO plus fake-syscall ownership/fault tests; no premature alias under queue saturation.

FfsTransport.send polls first; recv polls before and after successful receive. Late errors and partial submissions abort; exact identity mismatch retains the slot and close fails rather than releasing it.

release_endpoints unbinds before writer close; failed writer close retains _request_writer, closes endpoint descriptors in finally and skips rebind. Full close has the same writer/fd behavior. Existing daemon close_resources captures cleanup failure and main loop remains blocked.

32KiB logical envelopes remain exact across physical 8KiB segmentation. Full-envelope replay dispatches once after whole-payload CRC; malformed CRC, missing chunk, interleaving, conflicting replay, stale input fail without infer. Five raw8KiB replay positions fail actual parser/CRC before infer dispatch.

SessionLease applies only Linux+Jetson marker+UsbBulkTransport+exact env selector1, passing claimed bus/address to child. Helper restricts VID:PID1209:0001, exact identity, USB3 speed, devices subtree port, valid permit values; no global USB/runtime-autosuspend writes.

CarrotSession.handle touches before message-content routing. Parent writes only fixed b1 heartbeat at most1Hz on nonblocking pipe; no model/input bytes or model-content predicate. Root/helper filesystem control runs outside inference.

Mock sysfs and real ordinary owner pipe cover original u1/u2/u1_u2 restoration, quiet30s, EOF, identity/inode change, retained journal on failed restoration, same-boot recovery, old-boot discard, preserving external changes. Server finally releases lease even if other cleanup throws.

Changed AGENTS/docs reviewed as data. Historical CI/physical/latency counts excluded from fresh142. Documentation distinguishes early opt-in commits from later enabled defaults, preserves failed trials and partial-envelope replay/latency limits.
No comma/Jetson connection, USB device open, actual sysfs access, physical timing, build/load/inference, capture, ticket, storage or restart action performed.

CARROT_USB_LPM_OFF.absent: enabled on Linux Jetson claimed UsbBulkTransport only

selectors.negotiation: request_chunks path remains protocol2 exact-Jetson capability; no new protocol3/V3 model support is established here

limitations: Physical USB, kernel4.9 FunctionFS, Jetson power transitions, devices, 20Hz behavior, and performance/road claims are NOT_RUN. WSL Linux x86_64 is not actual comma/Jetson.
8KiB physical replay is fail-closed, not transparent recovery of arbitrary sub-envelope replay; CRC32 provides accidental corruption detection, not authentication.

Deferred close waits up to0.5s for pending completions then retains context/buffers on timeout. io_destroy remains a kernel syscall after that gate; no hard bound on arbitrary kernel teardown is proven.

Fake wrong-sequence completion intentionally consumes an unmatchable event. Two private fault contexts remain retained until that test process exits, with zero io_destroy calls; no fake recovery completion was injected.

Lease helper can outlive the3s parent close wait while kernel restoration is pending. Code logs and never kills the restorer; journal recovery requires a later helper. Mock tests do not prove physical restoration timing.
Historical document claims, public CI IDs, signed host bundles and measured device traces were not revalidated or counted in this offline audit.

Superseded initial private run:28 PASS/1 FAIL in a fixture whose mock restore callback referenced removed device state files. Corrected only private test callback to model the independently surviving port; final34 tests pass. Initial JUnit retained and excluded from fresh total.
